**Extraction notes:**

**Subgroup:** `SI_plus_mouthrinse` — the intervention was scaling and root planing with subgingival irrigation using chlorhexidine 0.12% antiseptic mouthwash; the control arm received delayed treatment (usual care).

**Why means/SDs are NR for all follow-up rows:** The paper used non-parametric statistics (Mann-Whitney U) because variables failed the Shapiro-Wilk normality test. Table 2 (the only descriptive statistics table) covers **baseline only**. At 3 months and 6 months, the paper reports only **medians** in the results text (e.g., HbA1c IG Mdn=7.25 vs CG Mdn=7.65 at 3 months; IG Mdn=7.2 vs CG Mdn=7.3 at 6 months). No means or SDs are published for any follow-up timepoint.

**N values:** CONSORT diagram and text confirm n=90 analyzed per arm at the 6-month primary endpoint; the same cohort provided 3-month data, so n=90 is used for both timepoints.

**Outcomes covered:** HbA1c, PI, GI, PPD (paper calls it PD/pocket depth), and CAL — all measured at both 3-month and 6-month follow-ups. BOP is mentioned in a table footnote but has no reported values.
